create_LazyCall: create a LazyCall wrapper around a callable to defer instantiation until later
load_LazyConfig: load a Python or YAML config file into an omegaconf DictConfig object
save_LazyConfig: save an omegaconf config object to a YAML file with cloudpickle fallback
apply_overrides_LazyConfig: apply command-style override strings like 'a.b=c' to an omegaconf config in place
to_py_LazyConfig: convert an omegaconf config object into formatted Python source code using black
